Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Scope of Work The CAMC shall include comprehensive preventive and breakdown maintenance of all the above

air conditioners along with replacement of defective spare parts. The scope shal l include, but not be limited to, the following: A. Preventive Maintenance The contractor shall carry out preventive maintenance once every quarter (mini mum four services in a year) or as directed by the Institute. Each service shall include: � Cleaning of indoor unit. � Cleaning of outdoor condenser unit. � Cleaning/washing of air filters. � Cleaning of evaporator and condenser coils using suitable chemicals. � Checking and tightening of all electrical connections. � Checking compressor operation. � Checking condenser and evaporator fan motors. � Checking blower motor. � Inspection of thermostat and temperature calibration. � Inspection of PCB and control circuits. � Checking refrigerant gas pressure. � Leak detection and rectification. � Lubrication of moving parts wherever required. � Cleaning of condensate drain tray and drain pipe. � Ensuring proper airflow and cooling efficiency. � Measurement of voltage, current and operating parameters. � Overall testing for satisfactory operation. B. Breakdown Maintenance The contractor shall attend all complaints related to malfunctioning of AC units t hroughout the contract period. The contractor shall: � Attend complaints within 24 hours of receipt either Phone /e mail. � Rectify minor faults within 24 hours. � Rectify major faults within 48–72 hours, depending upon availability of genuin e spare parts.

� Provide uninterrupted maintenance support during office working days and e mergency requirements. Failure to attend complaints within the stipulated period may attract penalty. B. Replacement of Spare Parts (Comprehensive) The CAMC shall include supply, replacement and installation of all defective spa re parts including labour charges. The following components shall be covered under CA MC: � Compressor � Condenser fan motor � Indoor blower motor � Capacitors � Starting relay � Overload protector � Contactor � PCB/control cards � Thermostat/temperature sensors � Remote receiver PCB � Swing motor � Refrigerant gas charging/top-up � Copper tubing repairs � Drain pipe � Electrical wiring � Power cable � Insulation materials � Fan blades,Bearings �Transformer � Solenoid valves (where applicable) � Any other component necessary for proper functioning of the AC. All replaced spare parts shall be new, genuine and of OEM or equivalent appr oved quality. C. Refrigerant Gas

The contractor shall provide: � Leak testing. � Leak rectification. � Vacuuming. � Gas charging/recharging/top-up whenever required. No separate payment shall be made for refrigerant gas. E. Consumables The AMC shall include supply of all consumables such as: � Nuts and bolts � PVC insulation tape � Cable ties � Screws � Fasteners � Sealants � Cleaning chemicals � Lubricants � Insulation sleeves � Electrical terminals No additional payment shall be made. F. Service Records The contractor shall maintain: � Preventive maintenance register. � Complaint register. � Breakdown maintenance report. � Spare replacement records. � Quarterly service reports duly certified by the Institute's authorized represent ative. G. Contractor's Responsibilities The contractor shall: � Deploy trained and experienced service personnel.

� Use proper tools and testing instruments. � Ensure safe working practices. � Follow electrical safety norms. � Protect Institute property while carrying out maintenance. � Remove replaced defective parts after obtaining approval from the Institute. H. Quality of Service � Cooling performance shall be restored to the manufacturer's specifications. � Only genuine spare parts shall be used. � The contractor shall ensure reliable and uninterrupted functioning of all AC un its throughout the contract period. I. Deployment of Service Personnel: � The contractor must deploy at least one qualified technician at the Campus pr emises during months from February to May during office hours i.e Monday to Friday 9AM to 6PM for immediate response to breakdowns and routine mainten ance. � The technician must be equipped with necessary tools and basic spares. J. Payment Terms � Payment shall be made quarterly after satisfactory completion of preventive maintenance and breakdown services, upon certification by the Officer-in-Ch arge. � Statutory deductions such as Income Tax, GST-TDS, or other applicable deduc tions shall be made as per Government rules. K. Penalty Clause � Delay in attending complaints beyond the stipulated response time may att ract a penalty A penalty of Rs.1000/- will be imposed if minor fault not rectified within 24 h ours and Rs.2000/- will be imposed if major fault not rectified within 72 hour s.

� Repeated failure to provide satisfactory service may lead to termination of the contract. 9. Purchase Preference (Centre) Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs): Purchase preference will be given to MSEs as defined in Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 dated 23.03.2012 issued by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Ministry. If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase preference, the bidder must be the manufacturer of the offered product in case of bid for supply of goods. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service. If L-1 is not an MSE and MSE Seller (s) has/have quoted price within L-1+ 15% of margin of purchase preference /price band defined in relevant policy, such Seller shall be given opportunity to match L-1 price and contract will be awarded for percentage of 15% of total value. 10. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c.
